> As all the Daughters of Cacophony are female, may a male vampire Clan
> Impersonate into that Clan ? :)

Well, thematically speaking, there WERE a handful of male Daughters of
Cacophany (they were called Sons of Discord), but the Daughters purged
them all from their ranks a couple of years ago.

However, none of this is reflected by any means as a rule in the card
game, so yes, a male vampire could Clan Impersonate a Daughter of
Cacophany.

NO, NO, NO, NO, NO!!!! Yes, there were male members of the Daughters of
Cacophony but they were never actually called the Sons of Discord! It was just
some weird little net-rumour that really spread around. In fact, one time
Justin even asked where people were coming up with this "Sons of Discord"
stuff! In any case, once Revised came around, I think the Daughters had a
little culling and killed off (most) of the male members. There are at least
two canon male Daughters still alive, though they both happen to be
transvestites. Go figure.
